text:
alex: Customer reports python generator stops yielding in the middle of a streamed response after an auth refresh. Seen on 0.12.0 SDK.

maria: summary? repro steps?

alex: short: model streaming works for ~3-5 tokens then generator never yields again. connection stays open, TCP still alive, no exception. only way to recover is kill process.

alex: env: python 3.11, redwood-sdk==0.12.0, requests, ubuntu 22.04. occurs intermittently but 6/10 for this customer.

alex: minimal repro they gave:```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
with c.stream(model='redwood-2b', input='Say hello one word at a time.', timeout=None) as gen:
    for ev in gen:
        print(ev)
```

maria: any logs from SDK or server side?

alex: customer paste: connection chunk dump shows SSE partial JSON then a keepalive-only frame, after that SDK stops parsing. snippet:```
data: {"id":"resp-1","delta":"Hel"
\n: keepalive
\ndata: {"id":"resp-1","delta":"lo"}
```

devx-sara: interesting — looks like an event boundary with a keepalive between halves of a single logical token. parser treating keepalive as separator and dropping buffered partial data.

eng-aaron: can you confirm SDK version differences? did they try 0.11.x?

alex: they downgraded to 0.11.5 and it worked reliably in their workload. 0.12.0 introduced streaming parser refactor + new auth refresh thread.

eng-aaron: likely race between auth refresh re-subscribing and SSE chunk parser flush. if auth rotates mid-response and the client injects a heartbeat or empty comment line, buffer state machine may discard partial `data:` lines.

alex: attaching more raw dump from tcp:```
:keepalive
data: {"id":"resp-1","delta":"Wor"
\n: keepalive
data: {"id":"resp-1","delta":"ld"}



```

maria: customer also reported they were using our token rotation library that calls client.refresh_token() on a background thread. maybe that triggers small delay and a keepalive is sent.

devx-sara: workaround for customers - set env var to disable auth background rotation and perform rotation synchronously between streams. also try redwood-sdk==0.12.1-rc which includes a partial-fix.

alex: reproduced locally with a short script that injects a comment line mid-stream. will capture minimal repro harness.

alex: repro harness (server simulator):```python
# tiny SSE server that splits tokens with keepalive
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import time
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type','text/event-stream')
        self.send_header('Cache-Control','no-cache')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'data: {"id":"r","delta":"Hel"}\n\n')
        self.wfile.flush()
        time.sleep(0.2)
        self.wfile.write(b': keepalive\n\n')
        self.wfile.flush()
        time.sleep(0.2)
        self.wfile.write(b'data: {"id":"r","delta":"lo"}\n\n')
        self.wfile.flush()
        time.sleep(0.5)

HTTPServer(('localhost', 8765), H).serve_forever()
```

alex: running this against 0.12.0 client -> generator yields first event then hangs. against 0.11.5 -> yields both.

eng-aaron: thanks. we should patch parser to accumulate across comment-only frames and only flush on a full event boundary where `data:` line(s) are complete. also avoid clearing buffer on `:` lines. I'll open a PR.

eng-aaron: interim hotfix: in streaming.py change:```py
# before: on_comment() -> reset buffer
# after: on_comment() -> ignore unless event complete
```

devx-sara: also add a feature flag while we test: REDWOOD_SDK_SSE_STRICT=false (defaults true currently). document in release notes.

maria: can you provide repro steps we can send to customer (they asked for a test to run before upgrade)?

alex: send them the server simulator above and these steps: 1) pip install redwood-sdk==0.11.5 2) run simulator 3) run client script (provided) — observe stream completes. 4) pip install redwood-sdk==0.12.0 -> hangs. 5) pip install redwood-sdk==0.12.1rc -> validate fix.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026, priority P2. Assigned to @eng-aaron.

eng-aaron: I'll land the parser fix + unit tests to cover comment lines between data frames. target patch to 0.12.1 and cherry-pick to 0.12.0 hotfix if customer needs immediate patch.

maria: update customer that we're actively investigating and provide the workaround (downgrade or disable background rotation). ask if they can test the rc.

alex: noted. I'll reply to them with the simulator + steps and schedule a call if needed. :thumbsup:

devx-sara: follow-up: add e2e test in CI that simulates keepalive/comment interleaving with partial JSON events to prevent regressions.

eng-aaron: agreed. created PR #4234 with parser change and tests. will tag release once merged.

alex: thanks team, keeping thread open until customer validates.
